text: Well, you can't win them all, my friend. Better luck next time.
source_text: Well, you can't win them all, my friend. Better luck next time.

text: Well, you can't win them all, my friend. Better luck next time.
source_text: Well, you can't win them all, my friend. Better luck next time.

text: You might try signing up with Gizmo. I hear he's always looking for new meat to toss in the ring.
source_text: You might try signing up with Gizmo. I hear he's always looking for new meat to toss in the ring.

text: Try again tomorrow. Saul will be boxing then.
source_text: Try again tomorrow. Saul will be boxing then.

text: You just missed it. Try again in a couple of days. Saul boxes every three days.
source_text: You just missed it. Try again in a couple of days. Saul boxes every three days.

text: Saul is the local champion. Saul is the current favorite of Gizmo.
source_text: Saul is the local champion. Saul is the current favorite of Gizmo.

text: Try again the day after tomorrow.
source_text: Try again the day after tomorrow.

text: So! Want to lay a bet on the fight?
source_text: So! Want to lay a bet on the fight?

text: I've got better things to do with my money. Goodbye.
source_text: I've got better things to do with my money. Goodbye.

text: No, thanks. Mind if I ask a few questions, though?
source_text: No, thanks. Mind if I ask a few questions, though?

text: 你应该试着向吉斯莫找工作。我听说他总是在找新人进拳击场。
source_text: 你应该试着向吉斯莫找工作。我听说他总是在找新人进拳击场。

text: 明天再来试吧。你会在拳击场上见到索尔。
source_text: 明天再来试吧。你会在拳击场上见到索尔。

text: 你刚错过了，两三天后再来，索尔每三天有一场比赛。
source_text: 你刚错过了，两三天后再来，索尔每三天有一场比赛。

text: 索尔是本地的拳击冠军，也是吉斯莫最得力的拳击手。
source_text: 索尔是本地的拳击冠军，也是吉斯莫最得力的拳击手。

text: 嘿，那里，今天没有拳击比赛。
source_text: 嘿，那里，今天没有拳击比赛。

text: 那么！你想在比赛中下赌注吗？
source_text: 那么！你想在比赛中下赌注吗？

text: 我的钱要用到刀口上，再见。
source_text: 我的钱要用到刀口上，再见。

text: 不，多谢。我能问些问题吗？
source_text: 不，多谢。我能问些问题吗？

text: Sorry, but today's match is already over.
source_text: Sorry, but today's match is already over.

text: Who do you want to bet on, Saul or the challenger? Odds favor Saul winning. Cost is 25 caps to bet; you get 50 if you win betting on Saul, 100 if you win betting on the challenger!
source_text: Who do you want to bet on, Saul or the challenger? Odds favor Saul winning. Cost is 25 caps to bet; you get 50 if you win betting on Saul, 100 if you win betting on the challenger!

text: Sorry, I don't have the time. Maybe later.
source_text: Sorry, I don't have the time. Maybe later.

text: Saul, the fastest fist in Junktown! He's a marvel of manly musculature! A pulsating power puncher!
source_text: Saul, the fastest fist in Junktown! He's a marvel of manly musculature! A pulsating power puncher!

text: Um, yeah. So, who runs these matches?
source_text: Um, yeah. So, who runs these matches?

text: Gizmo, the casino owner, employs Saul. He occasionally likes to watch a match or two, but mostly it's good money - people will bet a lot on a fight. And nobody has to get killed, unlike those death matches they supposedly have in the Hub.
source_text: Gizmo, the casino owner, employs Saul. He occasionally likes to watch a match or two, but mostly it's good money - people will bet a lot on a fight. And nobody has to get killed, unlike those death matches they supposedly have in the Hub.

text: Well, it's just a rumor. But they say there's an underground fighting ring there where you can pay to watch people fight to the death. Not my kind of fight.
source_text: Well, it's just a rumor. But they say there's an underground fighting ring there where you can pay to watch people fight to the death. Not my kind of fight.

text: 抱歉，今天的比赛结束了。
source_text: 抱歉，今天的比赛结束了。

text: 你想赌谁？索尔还是挑战者？押索尔要25个瓶盖，但能赢50个。压挑战者能赢100个！
source_text: 你想赌谁？索尔还是挑战者？押索尔要25个瓶盖，但能赢50个。压挑战者能赢100个！

text: 索尔，迦克镇出拳最快的拳击手！他的肌肉非常的夸张！他一拳就可以把人的身体打穿！
source_text: 索尔，迦克镇出拳最快的拳击手！他的肌肉非常的夸张！他一拳就可以把人的身体打穿！

text: 恩，好，谁组织的这些比赛。
source_text: 恩，好，谁组织的这些比赛。

text: 吉斯莫，是雇佣索尔的赌场老板。他偶尔来看一两场比赛，但绝大多数时间在背后组织－很多人会赌这种拳击比赛。这里不会死人，不像哈勃那些杀人比赛。
source_text: 吉斯莫，是雇佣索尔的赌场老板。他偶尔来看一两场比赛，但绝大多数时间在背后组织－很多人会赌这种拳击比赛。这里不会死人，不像哈勃那些杀人比赛。

text: 嗯，只是“据说”这样。但是他们说有一个地下拳击场，你付钱就能看到他们至死方休。不是现在的这种。
source_text: 嗯，只是“据说”这样。但是他们说有一个地下拳击场，你付钱就能看到他们至死方休。不是现在的这种。

text: Uh, no. Never mind. Forget I said anything.
source_text: Uh, no. Never mind. Forget I said anything.

text: Well, well, looks like you're a winner! Here's your caps.
source_text: Well, well, looks like you're a winner! Here's your caps.

text: Come back when you have enough caps to bet!
source_text: Come back when you have enough caps to bet!

text: Would you like to wait here until the fight starts at 2:00?
source_text: Would you like to wait here until the fight starts at 2:00?

text: Nah, I got stuff to do. I'll be back later.
source_text: Nah, I got stuff to do. I'll be back later.

text: Okay, but if you miss, the fight, you forfeit your bet!
source_text: Okay, but if you miss, the fight, you forfeit your bet!

text: Please don't disturb me while the match is in progress.
source_text: Please don't disturb me while the match is in progress.

text: 你是想干些什么吧，失败者？
source_text: 你是想干些什么吧，失败者？

text: 哦不，别在意，忘了我所说的。
source_text: 哦不，别在意，忘了我所说的。

text: 哈哈，好像你是一个获胜者！给你的瓶盖。
source_text: 哈哈，好像你是一个获胜者！给你的瓶盖。

text: 等你有了足够的瓶盖再回来吧！
source_text: 等你有了足够的瓶盖再回来吧！

text: 你想在这里等2:00的比赛吗？
source_text: 你想在这里等2:00的比赛吗？

text: 不了，我知道怎么做了。我一会回来。
source_text: 不了，我知道怎么做了。我一会回来。

text: 那你要是错过了比赛，你的赌注就没了！
source_text: 那你要是错过了比赛，你的赌注就没了！

text: 你没能全赢他们，朋友，下次好运。
source_text: 你没能全赢他们，朋友，下次好运。

text: 你没能全赢他们，宝贝儿，下次好运。
source_text: 你没能全赢他们，宝贝儿，下次好运。

text: 抱歉，一次比赛只能赌一次。
